from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u019/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    shape = max(comps, key=len)
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in shape), max(r for r,c in shape)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in shape), max(c for r,c in shape)
    template = [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c]) for r,c in shape]
    ar, ac = (r1-r0)//2, (c1-c0)//2
    shape_cells = set(shape)
    markers = [(r,c) for comp in comps if comp is not shape for r,c in comp]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers:
        out[r][c] = bg
    for r,c in markers:
        for dr,dc,color in template:
            y, x = r + dr-ar, c + dc-ac
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-8df5b216.py'
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(path),'exec'),globals())
print(path)
